verdict.rationale: Datadog documents Bits AI, its AI assistant, and an official MCP server that lets AI agents query and operate the platform; a probe confirmed the MCP server docs exist. A ChatGPT Experiments plugin also allows conversational analysis of experiment data. Together these point to natural-language operation, but the evidence is mostly page titles with little detail on what commands are supported. missing for 10: detailed docs on which actions Bits AI can take from natural-language prompts, the scope of MCP tools (read-only vs. write actions such as creating monitors or dashboards), hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
